Submit the completed application form along with the documents in person at the office of the concerned Nagarasabhe - Ramanagara, Channapatna, or Kanakapura - during office hours.

important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only for the Nagarasabhe where the candidate is currently working or resident, as specified in the notification. Only one family member of a deceased Pourakarmika will be considered for appointment under the compassionate category. Appointment on a Neravu Paavathi basis is temporary/provisional in nature and does not entitle the candidate to regularisation, pension, or other permanent-employee benefits, whether by administrative decision or court order. Selected candidates must submit a written undertaking, on stamp paper, acknowledging the temporary nature of the appointment. Candidates must be mentally and physically fit to perform sanitation duties without risk to themselves or others, as certified by a government doctor. Persons appointed under this scheme can be assigned only sanitation-related (cleanliness) work and cannot be deployed for any other duty, including office work. No claim to seniority for any other post can be made on the basis of the date of appointment under this scheme. Submission of false documents or information, or use of unfair means, will result in removal from duty and appropriate legal/disciplinary action. Candidates must not have any pending criminal case and must not have been dismissed from any earlier government or similar service. All decisions relating to correction, transfer, and cancellation of this recruitment process rest with the Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru South District, as Chairman of the Appointment Committee.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 102 Pourakarmika posts are to be filled on a Neravu Paavathi (direct wage) basis across the three Nagarasabhes in Bengaluru South District, as per the table below. The notification does not specify a category-wise (SC/ST/OBC) reservation breakup for these posts, since, as clarified in the official notification, the Karnataka reservation act applicable to direct recruitment does not extend to appointments made on a Neravu Paavathi basis.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 must be Indian citizens who meet the age limit and language requirement, and applications are accepted only for the Nagarasabhe where the candidate is currently working or resident, as specified in the notification. No formal educational qualification has been prescribed for this recruitment. The notification requires only that the candidate be able to speak Kannada, supported by a self-declaration of Kannada language knowledge submitted with the application. Age can be verified through a birth certificate, SSLC marksheet, Aadhaar card, PAN card, or, for candidates already working in a Nagarasabhe, documents showing their ESI/PF enrolment date. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notification for any category, and reservation-related age relaxation does not apply since this recruitment falls outside the scope of the Karnataka reservation act for direct recruitment. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. Since this is a Neravu Paavathi (wage-basis) recruitment rather than an open competitive process, the notification lists specific categories of candidates who will be given priority: Candidates who have worked for a minimum of one year as a Pourakarmika, Loader, UGD Helper, Driver, or Helper on a daily wage, "dinagooli," or contract (guttige) basis in the concerned Nagarasabhe in Bengaluru South District. One family member of a Pourakarmika (working on a daily wage basis) who died while on duty due to COVID-19 or other reasons, for consideration under compassionate/Neravu Paavathi appointment. Locally self-employed or experienced persons who have worked for at least one year on a daily wage basis as Loaders, UGD Helpers, Drivers, Helpers, or in waste-management units, public toilets, or waste-segregation units in the Bengaluru South District Nagarasabhes. Candidates who belong to, or are family members of, a person recognised as a Manual Scavenger under the Manual Scavengers Act. Prior experience claims must be supported by a bank passbook showing ESI/PF or wage credit, along with attendance records certified by the concerned Pourayukta (Municipal Commissioner/Chief Officer).

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Salary
content_sections.text: Wages for candidates appointed on a Neravu Paavathi basis will be fixed as per the minimum wages notified by the Labour Department, as revised from time to time, along with Provident Fund (PF) and Employees' State Insurance (ESI) benefits. The exact wage amount is not specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Selection Process
content_sections.text: No written examination or personal interview is prescribed for this recruitment. Applications received will be scrutinised by the Pourakarmika Neravu Paavathi Recruitment Appointment Committee, chaired by the Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru South District. Selection will be based on the priority criteria listed above - prior work experience in the concerned Nagarasabhe, compassionate cases of deceased Pourakarmikas' families, and membership of the Manual Scavenger community - along with verification of submitted documents. The final decision on appointment rests with the Appointment Committee.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Documents Required
content_sections.text: Age proof: Birth certificate / SSLC marksheet / Aadhaar card / PAN card For candidates already engaged in a Nagarasabhe: documents showing ESI/PF enrolment/registration date Bank passbook showing ESI/PF or wage credit, as proof of prior work experience Attendance records certified by the concerned Pourayukta (for experience claims) Medical fitness certificate issued by a government doctor Self-declaration of Kannada language knowledge Caste/community certificate, for candidates claiming eligibility under the Manual Scavenger category Death certificate and legal heir/family certificate, for candidates applying under the compassionate (deceased Pourakarmika family) category

faq.question: Q1. What is Bengaluru South Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification issued by the Deputy Commissioner, Bengaluru South District, through the District Urban Development Cell (DUDC), Ramanagara, to fill 102 Pourakarmika posts on a Neravu Paavathi (direct wage) basis across Ramanagara, Channapatna, and Kanakapura Nagarasabhes.

faq.question: Q2. How many Pourakarmika vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 102 vacancies are available: 45 in Ramanagara Nagarasabhe, 36 in Channapatna Nagarasabhe, and 21 in Kanakapura Nagarasabhe.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form is 05.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM, at the concerned Nagarasabhe office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and not exceed 50 years of age, as on the date of the public notification (31.07.2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: No formal educational qualification is prescribed. Candidates only need to be able to speak Kannada, supported by a self-declaration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, in the prescribed format, in person at the office of the concerned Nagarasabhe (Ramanagara, Channapatna, or Kanakapura).

faq.question: Q7. Who gets priority in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Priority is given to candidates with at least one year of prior experience as a Pourakarmika or related worker in the concerned Nagarasabhe, one family member of a Pourakarmika who died on duty, locally experienced sanitation/waste-management workers, and members of the notified Manual Scavenger community.
